description: Update an existing invoice by ID.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

businessDetails.description: Business details object (name, address, phone, email, website, logoUrl, customValues)

contactDetails.description: Contact details object (name, email, phone, address, etc.)

items.description: Array of line item objects (name, description, quantity, unitPrice, taxes, etc.)

liveMode.description: Whether the invoice is in live mode (true) or test mode (false)

locationId.description: Location ID the invoice belongs to

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

sentTo.description: Recipient details for sending the invoice

termsNotes.description: Terms and notes text displayed on the invoice

title.description: Invoice title displayed at the top of the invoice

name: crm_update_invoice
